description: Skills and creep moves (V2_SPEC §4.6, P-54, P-55). 'scaling' says what powers the move: WEAPON uses the attack rating, MIND and ARCANE the spell powers; creeps always use their atk. 'unlock': START (in the opening loadout), DIALOGUE (taught by a LEARN_SKILL effect), LOCKED (a later region), CREEP (enemies only). A telegraphed move is announced one enemy turn before it lands.

skills.name: Rending Cut
skills.description: A dragging cut that opens a wound.

skills.name: Crystal Pulse
skills.description: The Heartshard's light, thrown like a stone.

skills.name: Ember
skills.description: Forge heat called into an open hand.

skills.name: Frost Shard
skills.description: A splinter of winter. Nobody in Eldmere knows the words.

skills.name: Mire Spit
skills.description: A gob of black marsh water.

skills.name: Frenzy
skills.telegraphLine: The {name} bristles, sparks crawling over its fur!
skills.description: A storm of teeth and claws.

skills.name: Heavy Swing
skills.telegraphLine: The {name} draws his blade back over his shoulder!

skills.name: Upheaval
skills.telegraphLine: The {name} burrows, and the ground shudders under your feet!

skills.name: Strike
skills.description: A lunge too quick to see.

skills.name: Cinder Touch
skills.description: Grey fire that gives no warmth.

skills.name: Flare
skills.description: The wisp flares into a sheet of ash.

skills.name: Grave Bite
skills.telegraphLine: The {name}'s jaw unhinges, wider than any jaw should!
skills.description: Everything a grave keeps, in one bite.
